description: L1 planner (estimate only): read the estimate messages of pool/l1 of a finished l4 module, inventory the existing l1, write pool/l2/web/backend.json, trace, then delete the consumed messages. Writes and deletes nothing in l1/ or l2/.
principles: Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
Pipeline state lives on disk at l4/{module}/pool/l1/pipeline.json (planning only writes the pool, 27/09). It is not a pool message. The task record is orchestration, not truth.
A step declared here and not implemented stops the run with pipeline.status awaitingStep naming that step. The task completes without failed.

Two entries, one path: a step created with prompt { moduleName, thread, file }, or @@agentPlannerL1 <lowerCamel> which reads every pool/l1 message from l2 whose artifact is needs.json. Both write the same pipeline.json.

Reads only the module l4, pool/l1, and the l1/l5 of the module. Writes only pool/l1/pipeline.json, pool/l1/plan20-draft.json, pool/l2/web/backend.json and one l1->l2 message. Never writes or deletes anything under l1/ or l2/.
Deterministic first. entry10 has no LLM. plan20 spends one reasoning call only on the unmatched remainder; no remainder means no LLM.
listPoolBox may list needs.json; entry10 keeps only files named <stamp>_<thread>_<round> whose from is l2.
Only mode estimate is the planner's. implement messages belong to agentDefsL1: ignored, never deleted; a box with only implement refuses.

Consumption: after backend.json, the l1->l2 message and the delivered trace, each message read at entry (sourceMessages) gets a processed trace and is then deleted with deletePoolMessageAt. Duplicates are listed in supersededMessages (the pool enum has no superseded outcome yet). A message that arrived after entry stays. A failure before the trace keeps the message; a re-entry after an approved plan20 only finishes the deletes.
The reply keeps the received round; the planner never increments it and never asks a human, so the three-round limit of the pool is owned by L2/L4.

invocation.fromPool: step prompt JSON { moduleName, thread, file }
invocation.moduleRule: The module token is required and must be lowerCamel. The name is never inferred from prose.
invocation.l4Rule: The module l4 pipeline.json must be status complete. Otherwise the run is refused.
invocation.poolRule: No pool message in pool/l1 refuses with 'nothing pending for <mod> in pool/l1'. needs.json is not a message.
invocation.needsRule: The oldest l2→l1 message must list pool/l1/web/needs.json. Missing file or unknown schemaVersion refuses.
invocation.dedupeRule: Messages with the same moduleName, mode and artifacts are one request. Two different requests refuse: 'pool/l1 has N different requests; resolve with the l2 planner'.

steps.goal: Read every pool/l1 message from l2 (oldest first), group identical requests, refuse if they differ, read needs.json, inventory the existing l1, drop the previous pool/l1 draft, write pool/l1/pipeline.json with sourceMessages and inventory. Finishes the deletes of an approved previous run first. Never writes or deletes l1/ or l2/.

Endpoints, usecases, ports and tables with OwnerStatus against the l1 inventory. One reasoning call only for what deterministic matching cannot resolve. No remainder means no LLM. Writes pool/l2/web/backend.json and an l1→l2 estimate message, closes the pipeline, then traces processed and deletes the consumed pool/l1 messages.
